name: North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services
source_citation: NC Department of Health and Human Services 2026-2030 Strategic Plan
mission: In collaboration with our partners, DHHS provides essential services to improve the health, safety and well-being of all North Carolinians.
funder_affinities: Department of Health and Human Services
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration

goals.title: Access to care
goals.citation: NC Department of Health and Human Services 2026-2030 Strategic Plan, p. 4
goals.description: Support North Carolinians' ability to safely, easily and fully access the services, programs and systems of care of NCDHHS and our partners.
objectives: 1.1 Maintain access to health and human services in traditional and non-traditional settings
1.2 Mitigate the social, cultural and literacy barriers that prevent North Carolinians from accessing health and human services

goals.title: Whole person well-being
goals.citation: NC Department of Health and Human Services 2026-2030 Strategic Plan, p. 5
goals.description: Improve the well-being of North Carolinians by delivering comprehensive, high-quality services that address complex factors shaping outcomes for individuals and families.
objectives: 2.2 Simplify the processes for families and individuals to navigate mental health, substance use disorder, I/DD and TBI systems and services
2.3 Improve systems that address non-medical drivers of health such as access to healthy food

goals.title: Transform and modernize health care
goals.citation: NC Department of Health and Human Services 2026-2030 Strategic Plan, p. 6
goals.description: Transform North Carolina's health care ecosystem by modernizing delivery, strengthening community and rural care, and optimizing strategic partnerships to expand access, improve outcomes and manage costs.
objectives: 3.3 Leverage the expertise of state-operated health care facilities to support individuals with complex needs
3.4 Promote a sustainable rural health delivery system

goals.title: Sustainable workforce
goals.citation: NC Department of Health and Human Services 2026-2030 Strategic Plan, p. 7
goals.description: Develop a skilled workforce that supports North Carolinians' health and well-being through training, career pathways and innovative strategies to attract and retain talent.
objectives: 4.1 Develop and strengthen career pathways that address critical service gaps in health and human services workforces
4.3 Support individuals with employment barriers to obtain work

goals.title: Organizational excellence
goals.citation: NC Department of Health and Human Services 2026-2030 Strategic Plan, p. 8
goals.description: Promote efficient and effective operations through continuous improvement, leveraging data, modernizing systems, using resources wisely and strengthening accountability and transparency.
objectives: 5.1 Modernize technology systems to enhance efficiency and collaboration
5.2 Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making
